Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Tehnologie, informații și mass-media și Servicii de inginerie
At Tata Technologies we make product development dreams a reality by designing, engineering and validating the products of tomorrow for the world’s leading manufacturers. Due to our continued growth, we are now recruiting for a Technical Support Analyst / Resolver (ServiceNow) with German. 
 Role Overview: 
 The Resolver provides first-level technical support using the ServiceNow platform. The role focuses on resolving access and application issues, monitoring support queues, assigning tickets to the correct teams, and helping maintain knowledge articles. Training and support provided.
 Key Responsibilities: 
Resolve Level 0 and Level 1 incidents 
Monitor ServiceNow queues and ensure tickets are: Correctly logged and categorized and Assigned to the appropriate support team
Communicate clearly with users regarding ticket status and resolution
Create and update knowledge articles and simple support documentation
Follow defined procedures, SLAs, and escalation paths
Escalate unresolved or complex issues to higher-level support teams
 Required Skills & Experience: 
Entry-level experience in aerospace engineering is a plus
Medium-level experience or strong interest in IT support / service desk
Advanced understanding of IT concepts (accounts, applications, incidents)
Willingness to learn ServiceNow and IT support processes
Advanced / expert written and verbal communication skills
Organized, reliable, and customer-focused
 Technical Skills: 
Familiarity with ticketing systems (ServiceNow is a plus, not required)
Advanced troubleshooting skills
Ability to follow step-by-step procedures and document work clearly
 Mandatory: 
German Language
English Language
 If you are passionate about bringing innovation to the projects, you work on then we would love to hear from you. 
 Tata Technologies: Engineering a better world. 
 Tata Technologies would like to thank all applicants for their interest; each application will be reviewed against the set criteria for the role. We would like to advise that only candidates under consideration will be contacted. If you do not hear from us within 10 working days following the closing date it will mean that unfortunately your application has not been successful. We will however retain your details for any suitable future opportunities.
